acceptance: After several consecutive clean scheduled runs, an owner decision to make the Windows comparison fail the workflow (or keep it advisory with a recorded reason)
description: The Windows cell of .github/workflows/tpcds-platform-identity.yml is advisory. It found a real defect (dsdgen ignored "-" options on Windows and generated SF 1 instead of 0.01, fixed in #2623); after the fix it reports 0 differences. As long as it is advisory, a Windows regression only appears in the job log.
